TORONTO – The Toronto Sceptres today announced its 2026-27 Professional Women’s Hockey League (PWHL) regular-season home opener will be played on Tuesday, Dec. 8 at 7 p.m. ET against PWHL Hamilton, marking an exciting return to Coca-Cola Coliseum for the inaugural matchup of a new neighbouring rivalry. The Sceptres home opener is presented by Canadian Tire Corporation. The Sceptres will make their regular-season debut on the road on Sunday, Dec. 6, at 2 p.m. ET against their other provincial rivals, the Ottawa Charge, at Canadian Tire Centre as part of the PWHL’s opening weekend that features all 12 teams in action. The complete regular-season schedule will be announced on Friday, Oct. 2. Tickets are on sale at 11 a.m. ET through Ticketmaster for the Sceptres home opener and can be purchased online
